name: burning-aethercharge-deals-two-damage-to-target-champion
notes: Burning Aethercharge: 'Deal 2 damage to target champion' used to never run (no target prompt, no damage).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Burning Aethercharge's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
